summary: Iter17 — three UX bug fixes verified end-to-end. CRITICAL regression discovered & fixed: GET /api/chat/sessions was returning 404 because chat.py's list_sessions() function had lost its @router.get('/sessions') decorator during the Bug 2 refactor — this broke the entire agent dashboard sessions listing. After adding the decorator, all 11 backend pytest cases pass and the full frontend flow works. Bug 1 (Playwright): selecting a session with 2 prior threads renders [data-testid='load-previous-chats-btn'] with text '↑ Load 2 previous chats' and ZERO [data-testid^='prior-thread-'] elements; clicking the button loads 2 prior-thread elements. Bug 2 (pytest): POST /api/chat/session/anonymous & POST /api/chat/session both return status='lily' and are excluded from default GET /api/chat/sessions listing; status_filter=lily returns them; POST /api/lily/handoff flips status to pending/queued/open and makes the session visible in the default listing; WS test confirms NO pending_offer at session creation but a broadcast fires after handoff. Bug 3 (Playwright timing): agent close-session-btn click → session-item disappears in 62ms; customer close-confirm-confirm click → 'Chat ended / Rate your experience' UI visible in 194ms. Both well under the 1s target.
action_items: CRITICAL (already fixed by testing agent): The @router.get('/sessions') decorator was missing on list_sessions() in /app/backend/routers/chat.py at line 245. Added it. Please review the fix and merge — without this line the entire agent dashboard cannot list sessions (returns 404).

Consider extracting the duplicated 'set status=lily / handled_by_lily=True / queue_position=None' block from POST /chat/session and POST /chat/session/anonymous into a helper (DRY, matches iter16's earlier suggestion).
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL: list_sessions was missing @router.get('/sessions') decorator — total endpoint outage on the agent dashboard listing. Fixed in this iteration.
AgentDashboard.jsx now 1160+ lines; still needs splitting per prior guidance.

closeSession's optimistic pattern is correct (patchSession + setSessions + setSelectedId(null) BEFORE api.post) but does not restore state on API failure. If /close returns non-2xx (network drop), the session vanishes locally forever until reload. Consider a rollback on catch or a background retry.
ChatWidget.confirmClose fires POST in background — same fire-and-forget concern: an offline customer will see 'Chat ended' locally but the server session remains open until inactivity timer.
customer_close_endpoint calls ai_summarize synchronously inside the request. For sub-1s guarantee end-to-end (backend included), consider moving summary generation to a background task.
seed_data_creation: Multiple anon sessions with client_id 'uitest_*' and 'iter17_prior_*' — some closed, current handed off. May accumulate; safe to purge via db.sessions.deleteMany({status:{$in:['lily','pending','queued','closed']}}) if noise builds up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login response key is 'token' (NOT 'access_token'). GET /api/chat/sessions requires an @router.get decorator that was momentarily missing — verify it stays present after any future refactor of chat.py. To create a customer with prior threads for Bug 1 UI testing, call /api/chat/session/anonymous with the SAME client_id repeatedly, then /api/lily/handoff and /api/chat/sessions/{id}/close for each older session. Admin is auto-online and receives pending offers deterministically when agent user is offline.
